title: TechnologyService
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — Technology Architecture building block. Extends Structure with TOGAF Technology Architecture vocabulary: service category, provider, management model. Used as archetype_id on Structure Ascriptions representing infrastructure and platform services. TOGAF mapping: Technology Service / Platform Service (Content Metamodel, Technology Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture, Content Framework).

serviceCategory.description: Infrastructure service functional category. TOGAF mapping: Technology Service classification in the Technology Architecture domain.

provider.description: Technology provider or platform vendor (e.g., 'azure', 'aws', 'gcp', 'on-premise'). Enables provider-level governance and migration analysis.

managementModel.description: Operational responsibility model. MANAGED = vendor-operated (PaaS/SaaS). SELF_HOSTED = organization-operated. HYBRID = shared responsibility.
